clauses.quote: Duties may not be assigned arbitrarily or capriciously.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit actor is management.

clauses.quote: If a teacher is required to follow a Board policy, or perform a duty that the teacher believes to be in violation of this Agreement, the appropriate course of action for the teacher is to use the grievance procedure provided herein.
clauses.subject_text: the appropriate course of action for the teacher
clauses.notes: Procedural guidance granting access to grievance mechanism.

clauses.quote: regular contract teachers doing satisfactory work will be continued in employment on a year-to-year basis until they retire.
clauses.subject_text: regular contract teachers doing satisfactory work

clauses.quote: Provisional contract teachers and specially funded program teachers shall sign the District's Special Employment Contract.
clauses.subject_text: Provisional contract teachers and specially funded program teachers

clauses.quote: Provisional contract teachers shall have no right or expectation of continued employment beyond the term specified in their Special Employment Contract.
clauses.notes: Denies worker expectation; protects management's non-renewal right.

clauses.quote: Specially Funded Program teachers doing satisfactory work, who have completed their three-year provisional period, may expect continued employment in successive years, unless there is a curtailment or discontinuance of funds in their program.
clauses.subject_text: Specially Funded Program teachers doing satisfactory work, who have completed their three-year provisional period

clauses.quote: Any such curtailment or discontinuance of funds shall justify non-renewal of teacher contracts in that program.
clauses.subject_text: Any such curtailment or discontinuance of funds

clauses.quote: Such non-renewals shall not be considered a violation of this Agreement
the teachers involved shall not be entitled to a formal hearing under the Utah Orderly School Termination Procedures Act.
The determination of contract FTE for secondary teachers shall be based on the number of teaching periods or teaching blocks assigned.
clauses.subject_text: The determination of contract FTE for secondary teachers
